question:
Identify and correct the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.

Sliding each bead from one side to the other, the student used the abacus to count out the nember of days in a week.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"nember"** is a misspelling and does not have a meaning in English. (ग़लत वर्तनी)
 
• **"Number" **refers to a mathematical object used to count, measure, and label. (संख्या)
 
 
• **Example: **She can count to any **number** effortlessly.
 
 

Hence, the correct spelling is** 'Number'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Beed **(माला का मनका):This is a misspelling "**Bead**" here, which means** a small, typically round object used in jewelry or counting**.

 
 
• **Example:** She wore a necklace made of colorful **beads.**
 
 
 
• **Slaiding **(स्लाइडिंग): This is a misspelling of **"sliding**," which means **moving smoothly along a surface**.
 
 
• **Example: **The children enjoyed** sliding **down the hill.
 
 
 
• **Abacuss** (अभ्यास): This is a misspelling of "**abacus**," which is **a simple device for calculating**.
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher used an **abacus **to help the students learn basic arithmetic.
